method: Rows are derived from the accepted ui-grant-scope-matrix warts (5), its unavailable org-scope rows and its 17 CLI/config-only groups (62 endpoints), plus the 4 unavailable records in ui-capability-matrix; MA-60..62 (SCIM token admin) and MA-73..75 (policy-packs) come from the task-brief verification set, not the matrix inputs. Every file:line citation in this file was resolved mechanically from the source at the recorded base commit. Client-absence claims were re-verified with case-insensitive searches (grep -ri) over web/dashboard/src (excluding *.test.*) so differently-cased spellings cannot split an enumeration; negative checks are encoded in this JSON and re-run by the checker.

scope_limit.statement: The binding set is exactly the source-matrix and task-brief inputs named in method. Independent review found 22 further live admin handlers with no dashboard caller that are absent from those inputs and from this enumeration; they are out of scope here and recorded as a follow-up gap for the owner (no binding work done for them in this document).

verdict_rule: bound-in-full: the operator can drive the action from the dashboard at HEAD — handler, route registration, OpenAPI entry, dashboard API client and accepted evidence all have citations. residual-only: at least one of those links has no citation; the residual field names the missing link(s). Deliberate non-dashboard surfaces (IdP protocol, agent data plane, opt-in portal UI, gateway plane) are recorded as residual with the design disposition named, not as missing implementation.
